name: Johnson Property Solutions
description: Family-owned handyman and small-build business in Western Sydney. Two generations of tradesmen handle carpentry and decking, bathroom renovations, room additions and conversions, minor plumbing and home repairs across Penrith, Blacktown, Parramatta and The Hills.
